c1.title: Employment is no longer the only path
c1.body:
AI gives individuals the execution power of a team. It is also reshaping, unbundling, and replacing jobs, making traditional employment less secure.
Freelancers, independent creators, and one-person companies are positioned to benefit directly from this shift.

c2.title: Cardano reshapes economic relationships
c2.body:
Cardano is highly decentralized: anyone can run a node, operate a stake pool, and build a verifiable identity on an open network.
With liquid staking, individuals can build cash flow, reputation, and user relationships without taking custody of user assets.

c3.title: Where AI and blockchain converge
c3.body:
When individuals control their own productivity, cash flow, and user relationships, the starting point of a company changes.
A new kind of personal business can begin with one person, a team of agents, and an open network.

model.title: How we plan to make it work
model.summary:
Our first priority is to build multiple revenue streams so the company can keep running.
Once the basic pressure to survive is off the table, we can keep exploring what becomes possible when AI, Cardano, and a one-person company come together.

income.title: Build sustainable revenue
income.body:
Pao Pool provides a baseline source of income to cover AI, server, and node operating costs.
Investment returns, consulting work, and product revenue provide additional cash flow.

identity.title: Create more value for members
identity.body:
We use social platforms to deliver high-quality content to delegators. Delegators also receive priority or free access to products we build.
Our goal is to bridge Web2 and Web3, making delegation the starting point for how our products evolve.

relationship.title: Contribute to open source and governance
relationship.body:
We contribute to the Cardano ecosystem through open-source projects, tools, and governance.
We do not just use Cardano—we want to help build it.

perks.title: Why stake with us
perks.sub:
Delegate to Pao Pool and support our long-term operation.
Alongside Cardano protocol staking rewards, you’ll receive ongoing value through our content, products, and community.

i1.title: Join activities and community
i1.body: Get priority access to discussions, member activities, and community experiments run by Pao Studio.

i2.title: Receive exclusive content
i2.body: Get exclusive content and updates on AI, Cardano, and trading.

i3.title: Unlock product membership benefits
i3.body: Receive member features, early access, or exclusive benefits according to each Pao Studio product’s rules.

i4.title: Co-create products from the beginning
i4.body: Bring real problems, test unreleased features, and help shape what we build next.

tier.body: No subscription required. Delegating to Pao Pool gives you member status.

services.title: Build AI and blockchain products with us
services.body:
We provide product development and consulting services for AI agents, Cardano, and blockchain.
If you have a clear product brief or are looking for a long-term technical partner, get in touch.

cardano.title: How to Stake to PAO Pool?

step1.title: Go to Staking Page
step1.description: Click the "Stake" button to go to the staking page.

step2.title: Connect Wallet
step2.description: Click the Connect Wallet button to connect your Cardano wallet.

step3.title: Confirm Delegation
step3.description: Click "Delegate" and confirm the transaction to start earning ADA rewards!

starknet.title: How to Stake to Our Starknet Validator?

step1.title: Visit Staking Page
step1.description: Click the "Stake" button to go to the operation page.

step2.title: Connect Wallet
step2.description: In the top right corner, click "Connect Wallet" and authorize.

step3.title: Select Stake
step3.description: After wallet connection, find and click the "Stake" button below "Connect Wallet".

step4.title: Confirm Transaction
step4.description: Enter the amount you want to stake and the reward receiving address, click "Delegate" and confirm the transaction to start earning rewards.

starknet.note: For detailed tutorial, please refer to Starknet Official Guide.
